description: Manage your Agile CRM: create, find, update and tag contacts and companies, run deals through pipelines, add tasks, notes and calendar events, and start workflows when a contact, company or deal is added.

agile_crm_new_company_trigger.description: Runs for each new company in your Agile CRM account, with its name, email, phone and website. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The company's ID in Agile CRM.
output.name: The company's name.
output.owner_email: Email of the user who owns the company.

agile_crm_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in your Agile CRM account, with their name, email, phone and tags. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.company: The company they work at, if set.
output.id: The contact's ID in Agile CRM.
output.name: Their full name.
output.owner_email: Email of the user who owns the contact.
output.title: Their job title, if set.

agile_crm_new_deal_trigger.description: Runs for each new deal in your Agile CRM account, with its name, value, stage and contacts. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.close_date: When the deal is expected to close.
output.contacts: The contacts on the deal, each with an id and a name.
output.id: The deal's ID in Agile CRM.
output.milestone: The stage the deal is in.
output.name: The deal's name.
output.owner_email: Email of the user who owns the deal.
output.pipeline_id: The ID of the pipeline the deal is in.
